_comment: Killer Power add-ons the scrape source doesn't carry, hand-transcribed from that killer's own wiki page. Gated on releasedAt like everything else (scripts/release-gate.ts). Kept deliberately small: an entry is dead weight the moment the source catches up. The way to check whether one is still needed is to remove it and re-run the scraper — NOT to compare it against addons.json, which already contains whatever this file put there. That circular check is exactly how The Slasher nearly lost all twenty of its add-ons.

addons.name: Bent Wheel
addons.description: "All that remained of the victim's wheelchair after the fatal blow." Increases the Jump Scare targeting range by +4 metres.

addons.name: Garden Claw
addons.description: "Good for digging up weeds and digging into human flesh." Increases the duration of Killer Instinct after a Jump Scare by +2 seconds.

addons.name: Knitting Needle
addons.description: "You won't believe what—and who—this thing has been through." Increases the time it takes for Survivors to remove an impaled Hook Spike from themselves by +20 %.

addons.name: Orderly's Shoe
addons.description: "It hung from her twitching foot as the knife plunged into her belly." Increases the duration of the Haste Status Effect after a Jump Scare by +5 seconds.

addons.name: Bloody Smile
addons.description: "He wasn't happy after his face was smashed into a tree." Increase the detection ranges of Jump Scare and Omnipresent Evil by +4 metres.

addons.name: Coroner's Coffee
addons.description: "A cup of coffee that went unfinished." Increases the duration of Throwing Spike's push by +25 %. Gain +13 % Haste Status Effect for 3 seconds after injuring a Survivor with a Throwing Spike if they do not collide with the environment during the push.

addons.name: Party Noisemaker
addons.description: "A party instrument that tore through a woman's eyeball and gouged her brain." Breaking a Pallet or a Breakable Wall with Jump Scare reveals all Survivors further than 28 metres for 6 seconds.

addons.name: Sleeping Bag
addons.description: "An absolutely awful place to hide from a killer." After grabbing a Hook Spike while in Omnipresent Evil, Survivors who are within 10 metres of any Hook have their location revealed for 5 seconds.

addons.name: Toxic Waste
addons.description: "No one could survive being submerged in this poison." After performing a Jump Scare, Survivors within 10 metres of a Hook or a Scrap Pile are inflicted with the Oblivious Status Effect for 13 seconds.

addons.name: Eye Goop
addons.description: "What remains when a harpoon is shoved into one's eye." Gain the Undetectable Status Effect after grabbing a Hook Spike for 13 seconds.

addons.name: Imprinted Aluminum
addons.description: "It's either avant-garde artwork, or the horrified imprint of a woman whose face was slammed into it." Injuring a healthy Survivor with a Throwing Spike inflicts them with the Mangled and Haemorrhage Status Effects for 70 seconds.

addons.name: Mirror Shards
addons.description: "A weapon that dealt more than bad luck." Survivors are inflicted with the Broken Status Effect after extracting a Hook Spike from themselves for 40 seconds.

addons.name: Sauna Rock
addons.description: "Nicely weighted, could be used to crush a rib cage." After performing a Jump Scare, inflict all detected Survivors with the Exhausted Status Effect for 3 seconds.

addons.name: Two Nails
addons.description: "A reliable way to hold a corpse's wrist in place." Survivors that come within 1 metre of a Throwing Spike have their Aura revealed for 5 seconds.

addons.name: Bloody Magazine
addons.description: "The spattering of blood told the story of a brutal massacre." When a Hook Spike misses, all Survivors within 8 metres of the Hook Spike's impact zone scream and reveal their Auras for 3 seconds.

addons.name: Burnt Fuse
addons.description: "The surge of electricity was overwhelming. It left the man's flesh charred and smelling of cooked meat." When a Survivor is impaled by a Hook Spike, the Exit Gates are blocked for them and any Survivor within 13 metres. This effect persists for 5 seconds after the Survivor is no longer impaled.

addons.name: Deputy's Badge
addons.description: "The badge of an officer who discovered that some things aren't worth investigating." While in Omnipresent Evil, passing within 2 metres of a Generator causes the Generator to explode, lose -5 % progress and begin regressing. If a Survivor is repairing the Generator, all Survivors repairing it will instead get a special Skill Check. If the Skill Check is failed, the Generator loses -10 % additional progress on top of the base Skill Check penalty.

addons.name: Missing Corkscrew
addons.description: "It seems to always be missing when you need it on-hand." When a Survivor is impaled by a Hook Spike, they emit a 32 metre Terror Radius until the Hook Spike is removed. Gain the Undetectable Status Effect when impaling a Survivor with a Hook Spike. This effect persists for 13 seconds after the Survivor is no longer impaled.

addons.name: Dirty Money
addons.description: "No amount of money can save you from him." When a Generator is repaired, gain 2 tokens. When you vault a Window or break a Pallet or a Breakable Wall, consume 1 token and gain a regular Spike if you don't have one already.

addons.name: Iridescent Boat Motor
addons.description: "The blades are chipped and cracked, as if having cut through something solid." Passing through Windows while in Omnipresent Evil marks them for 13 seconds. Performing a Jump Scare blocks all marked Windows for 13 seconds.

addons.name: Heretic's Mark
addons.description: "Those who stray from the path shall never escape ostracization once they received the mark." When a cast Divine Light passes a Survivor within 1 metre without hitting them, they are revealed by Killer Instinct for 2 seconds.

addons.name: Koenrad's Gauntlet
addons.description: "When darkness threatened to swallow his flock, he led them towards the light." Increases the maximum duration of Divine Light control duration by +25 %. Decreases the maximum speed of controlled Divine Light by -10 %

addons.name: Prayer Kneeler
addons.description: "Suffer the pain of prayer, for the suffering of unbelievers is far worse." While controlling an obstructed Divine Light: Decrease its maximum speed by -99 %.

addons.name: Searcher's Skull
addons.description: "The skulls of the heretics shall be cleaned and displayed as a warning to others who might stray from the light." When a Survivor blinds you: The Survivor gains Heresy. If the Survivor is a Heretic, they become blinded themselves for 2.5 seconds.

addons.name: Aurora's Telereceptor
addons.description: "None should stare into the abyss with the wretched devices made by the heretics." Survivors who gain Heresy have their aura revealed for 4 seconds. They also see your aura for 4 seconds. Heretics see your aura for +2 seconds longer.

addons.name: Confessor's War Horn
addons.description: "The sound of the horn shall strike fear into the hearts of unbelievers and muster the will of the faithful." Survivors who gain Heresy are inflicted Exhausted Status Effect for 10 seconds.

addons.name: Magnetised Manacles
addons.description: "Those who do not go into hiding will be locked deep underground, far from the guiding light of the stars." Gain +1 Token when you send a Survivor with the lowest amount of Hook States to the Exile, up to 5 Tokens. For each token, increase the duration of Zealous when activated by +10 %

addons.name: Mark of the Adherent
addons.description: "Wear your faith proudly and permanently. Let it be a reminder to others that It is always present." While not Zealous, Divine Light's radius is +10 % larger.

addons.name: Undying Flame
addons.description: "The village of Dend was repentant in its last moments, but its remnants still burn to this day as a warning." While Zealous: Increase lifetime of the cast Divine Light by +200 %. Decrease the radius of Divine Light by -20 %. Increase Survivor Divine Light aura reading range by +200 %.

addons.name: Blindfold of the Devoted
addons.description: "Those who follow Gerhardt's path shall wear blindfolds, to remember the sacrifice he made for his prophecy." Sending a Survivor to the Exile with the lowest amount of Hook States reveals the auras of all other Survivors with the lowest amount of Hook States outside 32 metres for 5 seconds.

addons.name: Electric Torch
addons.description: "The faithful shall go out in great numbers at night, searching for the heretics who hide in the dark." Increases the maximum speed of the controlled Divine Light by +25 %. Increases movement speed while controlling Divine Light by +10 %.

addons.name: Holy Winged Icon
addons.description: "Clutch it to your chest and pray, lest your heart appear untrue to It." While casting Divine Light, press the Secondary Power button to cast it back towards your location. When cast this way: Minimum delay before it deals damage and inflicts Heresy is set to 0.4 seconds. Increase its maximum speed by +10 %. It only damages Heretics

addons.name: Order of Inquisition
addons.description: "All those who believe in Its glory are deputized to search for heretics. Trust not even your own neighbor." When Divine Light is cast, its radius starts -25 % smaller, but grows +50 % larger over a period of 1 second.

addons.name: Superheated Glass
addons.description: "The planet of Aleide was unrepentant; after their leader was Exiled, Its Divine Light turned the surface to glass." Decreases the duration of Zealous by -20 %. While Zealous, a cast Divine Light breaks all Breakable Walls and Pallets it passes through. Breaking an object this way causes Survivors within 12 metres to scream and gain Heresy.

addons.name: Chains of the Heretic
addons.description: "Examples shall be made of the loudest apostates. They shall be dragged through the streets in chains." While Zealous: Cast Divine Light will always be directed towards you. Minimum delay before cast Divine Light deals damage and inflicts Heresy is set to 0.35 seconds. Increases the maximum speed of controlled Divine Light by +100 %. Increases the maximum speed of cast Divine Light by +50 %.

addons.name: Crown of the Destroyer
addons.description: "The Creators saw this and bestowed upon It a crown and said, use this to bring light to the darkness." When a Survivor is rescued from the Exile, for 20 seconds: Your Terror Radius is reduced by -70 %. Your Terror Radius is copied to all Shrines of Judgment. Grants the Undetectable Status Effect.

addons.name: Eyes of Gerhardt
addons.description: "He rapturously tore the eyes from his face after seeing such brilliant visions of the future." When a Heretic completes a Generator, opens an Exit Gate or exits a Locker, all Heretics have their aura revealed for 5 seconds.

addons.name: Improvised Detonators
addons.description: "Like cowards, they strike with bombs in the night, afraid to let the light of day illuminate their blackened souls." If no Survivors are dead, sending a Survivor with the lowest amount of Hook States to the Exile grants +1 Token. When you reach 4 Tokens, the Generator with the highest progress explodes and loses -20 % progress.

addons.name: Mirror of the Creators
addons.description: "And They said unto It, take this mirror, and show them the error of their ways." Cast Divine Light reflects off the first 2 obstructions it would otherwise pass through. When reflecting, it pauses for 0.4 seconds before reflecting again.

addons.name: Obsidian Feather
addons.description: "Some villagers will carve feathers from rocks, hoping that their faith might protect them." You can no longer cancel nor manually cast the controlled Divine Light and it is automatically cast when it would instead time out. Increases movement speed while controlling Divine Light by +100 %. Decreases the maximum amount of time you can control Divine Light for by -25 %. Increases the recovery time after casting Divine Light by +10 %. Decreases the movement speed while recovering after casting Divine Light by -30 %.
